main_measure.name: mean unusual 3-day move of short cases (drift removed, sign flipped)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases clustered by day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 over >= 30 case-days and check passes; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 over >= 30 case-days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move, larger |forecast| half minus smaller half

decided_by: The t lies between -2 and 2, meeting neither the confirm nor the reject rule. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction +0.461 (below 1), 240 cases (30 needed).
reading: Situation checked as close location from the high (raw component, or recomputed from prices where not recorded) >= 0.8 with a short forecast, the profile being code-added and not rebuilt; a case is the first short bet (rise of |forecast| by >= 2 from its low since the last bet) in each 3-bar grid cell of a window with a full 3-bar return in it; drift is the coin's mean non-overlapping 3-bar return over all its windows; t is clustered by signal day; the median split puts |forecast| > median in the larger half.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +0.461 (below 1), 240 cases (30 needed)
